Subject: Claim Decision Regarding {CLAIM_NUMBER}

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim, {CLAIM_NUMBER}, regarding the collision that occurred on 2026-03-04. We are pleased to inform you that your claim has been approved.

The loss is covered under your collision coverage. According to your policy, [COLL-1] "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision... 'Collision' means the upset of your covered auto or its impact with another vehicle or object, including a parked vehicle, a pole, a guardrail, or a building."

As a result of this approval, the payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued, less your {DEDUCTIBLE}.

Next steps: Payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued within 5 business days.

If you have any questions regarding this decision, please contact us directly.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
